name: Pardon the Intrusion, I'm Home!
original_name: ただいま、おじゃまされます！
overview: Rinko, a quiet office worker and secret otaku, just wants to enjoy her anime in peace. But when a neighbor keeps banging on the wall, she asks her other neighbor, Satsuki, for help. Their attempt to resolve the issue goes wrong, leaving a hole in the wall that reveals…Usaharu-sensei, the creator of Rinko’s favorite manga?! Now with nowhere to hide, their lives begin to overlap in surprising ways!
